summary: Inventory application is serving HTTP on node1 TCP port 8181 with SELinux Enforcing. Apache, firewall access, SELinux port labeling, and application content persisted through the required node restart.
actions_performed: Configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181.
Persistently mapped TCP 8181 to SELinux type http_port_t.
Verified HTTP 200 using node1's managed IP.
Restarted node1 and verified full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
evidence.summary: Apache listens on 8181 and returns the Inventory Application with HTTP 200. SELinux is Enforcing, port 8181 is labeled http_port_t, content is httpd_sys_content_t, and no boot-time AVC denials were recorded.

Healthy baseline boot ID 49dafad6-5cc2-457a-b0f6-1219740a651e was captured, reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 6428a3af-0015-428f-8ba2-11ba4dcaffe7 proved restart. Afterward Apache was active and enabled, port 8181 listened, firewall and SELinux mappings persisted, and the application returned HTTP 200.
